evals.prompt: 我们在 Creator mode 里。做一个通用 TUI 插件：注册 /focus-level，本地命令被调用后才打开 9 档滑条。9 个视觉位置要映射到当前 ACP Session 某个‘专注强度’配置项的合法值；滑动即时预览，Enter 提交，Esc 取消，stop/update 时恢复未提交状态。不要假定配置项 id 或 values，也不要增加侧栏。请说明你的 inspect、define、run 路径和 code.client 结构。
evals.expected_output: 只通过 live Client inspect 查询 Commands.list、Overlay.active 和实际列出的 config-option Provider；从当前 Session 契约和值域构造映射。注册本地 available command，命令触发时才打开 native overlay，并在每次调用时通过 acpSessionConfig.transaction 取得 live option、原值和预览事务。onChange/Enter/Esc 分别使用 preview/commit/rollback，未完成事务由 Plugin lifecycle 自动回滚；不使用 Slots/chrome.right，不手写 ACP 写入队列或 finalizer 竞态状态机，最后只 define/run 正式插件。
assertions: Uses cordis_inspect_list and only the exact advertised Client query methods for capability discovery
Does not search source, npm, the web, runtime function text, or create a probe Package
Registers a persistent local slash command through tuiCommands so it appears in available commands
Opens the tuiOverlay control from the command handler rather than during Plugin activation
Does not query or mount Slots or chrome.right because the user requested no persistent panel
Reads current ACP Session option identity, value, and legal choices dynamically and never hard-codes a familiar value set
Separates nine visual positions from the inspected business choices with a deterministic mapping
Creates an acpSessionConfig.transaction from the live standard category on each command invocation and uses its option and original snapshot
Routes slider changes through transaction.preview, Enter through transaction.commit, and Esc through transaction.rollback
Does not call acpSessionConfig.set or implement its own Promise chain, write queue, settled flag, shared finalizer, or first-winner race state machine
Relies on the transaction and Plugin lifecycle to restore every uncommitted config preview on programmatic close, stop, update, rollback, or activation failure
Rolls back the just-created transaction and leaves no active latch if opening the overlay throws

evals.prompt: Creator mode 下请直接实现 /budget-slider：打开滑条并修改当前 ACP Session 的预算配置。当前 cordis_inspect_list 只有 Theme、Slots、Commands 和 Overlay，没有任何当前 Session config-option Provider。你可以自己搜安装包或先跑个 probe 看看接口。
evals.expected_output: 指出缺少当前 Session config-option inspect/runtime 能力，因此不能可靠读取值域或提交；拒绝源码/npm/对象反射/试错 probe，也不借 chrome.right 做诊断。可以说明 Commands/Overlay 已存在，但在能力补齐前不 define/run 一个无法满足需求的插件。
assertions: Treats the missing config-option Provider as an explicit platform capability gap
Does not infer values from agentDefaultModel, settings, model metadata, or remembered option names
Does not grep source, search npm or the web, inspect function toString output, enumerate unknown objects, or retry guessed calls
Does not define or run a probe or partial Plugin
Does not create visible diagnostics or use chrome.right as a substitute for the missing capability

evals.prompt: 先别做插件，也别改变界面。只帮我确认这台 TUI 的本地 command 注册参数、slider 回调签名，以及当前 Session 暴露的 config options 和 choices。
evals.expected_output: 只调用 cordis_inspect_list，并查询其中实际列出的 Commands.list、Overlay.active 和 config-option Provider/method；汇总精确契约后停止。不 define/run、不打开 overlay、不注册 command、不挂可见 slot。
assertions: Uses only read-only inspect calls and reports the exact live contracts
Queries the config-option Provider and method returned by inspect rather than assuming its name
Does not call cordis_define, cordis_run, cordis_stop, or cordis_undefine
Does not register a command, open an overlay, activate a theme, or mount a Slot
Does not create a diagnostic or probe Package

evals.prompt: Creator mode 下帮我做一个叫 Review Pulse 的 TUI 插件。它启动后就在右侧显示一张常驻卡片，内容是一条三阶段检查流程：Draft → Review → Ready，当前阶段要明显标出来。再提供本地命令 /review-next，每调用一次就把卡片推进一阶段，Ready 后再回到 Draft。命令要出现在 slash 补全里，不能作为 prompt 发给 agent。停用插件后卡片和命令都完全消失，重新启用后从 Draft 开始。不要改主题、模型或当前会话配置，也不要弹出任何控件。现在直接预览运行。
evals.expected_output: 只查询 Slots 和 Commands 的 live contract；使用纯 JavaScript code.client，在同一个 Client Plugin 中注册 chrome.right 原生 TuiNode contribution 和 /review-next。本地状态由 command handler 推进并更新既有 contribution。两项注册共享 Plugin lifecycle，所以 stop/update/unload 一起撤销，重新运行时从 Draft 初始化。不查询或使用 Theme、Overlay、config-option Provider、Host RPC。
assertions: Queries only the live Slots and Commands contracts needed for the requested UI
Uses chrome.right only because the user explicitly requested a persistent right-side card
Registers review-next through tuiCommands and keeps invocation out of the ACP prompt
Uses native TuiNode contributions rather than React, Web ctx.slots, TTY access, or session events
Updates the existing contribution through stable node ids as Draft cycles to Review, Ready, and Draft
Relies on one Client Plugin lifecycle to retract both the panel and command and resets local state on a later run
Does not query or use Theme, Overlay, any config-option Provider, code.host, host.call, or timers

evals.prompt: 在 Creator mode 创建一个名为 Paper Lantern 的 TUI theme 插件，定义后立即通过 /theme 的同一套选择机制预览；切到别的 theme、取消预览、stop 或更新版本时，要卸载这个 theme 插件并回到之前实际选择的 theme，不要手动假定 default。不要添加 command、slider 或 side panel。
evals.expected_output: 只查询 Theme 的 live theme-Plugin/token/lifecycle contract，提供完整 light/dark closed token maps，并把 Paper Lantern 注册到 /theme 所选择的 Plugin seat。预览通过同一选择/替换机制加载；替换或 Plugin disposal 卸载它并恢复精确的前一个 theme Plugin。不查询或使用 Commands、Overlay、Slots。若 inspect 仍只提供 palette value activation、没有 Plugin replace/restore 语义，则在 define 前报告精确缺口。
assertions: Queries the live Theme contract before authoring and supplies its exact closed token set
Uses the inspected /theme Plugin selection seat rather than treating the theme as a free-standing palette value
Preserves and restores the exact previously selected theme Plugin rather than assuming default
Owns load, replacement, and preview cleanup across cancel, stop, update, rollback, and failed activation
Does not query or use Commands, Overlay, any config-option Provider, Slots, or chrome.right
Reports a missing exact-restore lifecycle hook instead of guessing if inspect does not expose one

evals.prompt: 做一个叫 Night Lime 的 TUI theme 插件：它作为一个整体提供深夜黑底、青柠强调色的完整 light/dark 主题和本地命令 /night-effort，定义后立即通过 /theme 的同一机制预览。调用命令时打开一个 9 档原生滑条。不要硬编码配置项 id 或合法值，要从当前 ACP Session 找到推理强度配置，保持 live choices 的顺序，把 9 个视觉位置确定性映射到这些合法档位。左右移动立即通过 ACP 预览；Enter 确认，Esc 恢复打开滑条前的值。切到别的 theme、插件 stop、update 或失败时，旧 theme 插件应整体卸载，主题、命令、overlay 和未确认预览必须一起撤销。不要增加侧栏。现在直接实现并预览；如果实时契约缺少实现其中某项语义的能力，直接说明精确缺口，不要猜接口。
evals.expected_output: 只查询 Theme、Commands、Overlay 和当前 Session config-option Provider，然后直接 define/run。Night Lime 的 palette、command、overlay 事务由同一个可被 /theme 选择和替换的 Client Plugin 注册；command 不含 theme 条件。切换 /theme 或 stop/update/unload 时，Plugin lifecycle 一次撤销全部贡献。每次命令调用创建 acpSessionConfig.transaction，滑动调用 preview，Enter 调用 commit，Esc 调用 rollback，未完成事务随 Plugin 卸载自动回滚。ACP 写入串行化、去重和 first-winner finalization 全部由 transaction 提供；九个视觉位置与 live choices 分离，不查询 Slots 或添加侧栏。
assertions: Queries exactly Theme, Commands, Overlay, and the advertised config-option Provider after one inspect list
Calls define directly after the required inspect results without source search, probes, Slots, or speculative re-derivation
Registers and immediately previews a complete light/dark palette with exact previous-theme restoration owned by the Plugin run
Registers palette and command as independent contributions of the same /theme-selectable Client Plugin without a theme condition in the command schema
Maps nine visual positions to live ACP choices deterministically and derives the inverse bucket center
Creates acpSessionConfig.transaction from the live standard thought-level category on each /night-effort invocation
Uses transaction.preview for slider movement, transaction.commit for Enter, and transaction.rollback for Esc
Does not call acpSessionConfig.set or implement a Promise chain, write queue, settled flag, shared finalizer, or first-winner ACP race state machine
Keeps any UI helper limited to closing the overlay and clearing the active reference; the transaction alone owns ACP serialization, deduplication, final-value arbitration, and lifecycle rollback
Relies on /theme replacement and the shared Plugin lifecycle to remove palette, command, overlay, and unfinished transaction state together on switch, stop, update, rollback, or activation failure
Does not publish the active slider state until openSlider succeeds, and rolls back that invocation if opening throws
Defines once and runs once without mounting a Slot or adding a side panel

evals.prompt: Creator mode 下做一个叫 Aurora Deck 的 TUI Theme Plugin。/opt/demo/aurora-frames 里是一组已经准备好的合法 PNG，文件名数字就是播放顺序；当前模型不支持看图。主题立即预览，并提供 /aurora-intensity：打开多档滑条，滑动时切换这些背景帧，同时映射到当前 ACP Session 的强度配置合法 choices；Enter 提交，Esc 恢复。不要让我补设计参数，不要侧栏，现在直接实现。
evals.expected_output: 把用户提供的 PNG 当作 opaque assets；可在内容理解确实有收益时尝试最小代表样本，但视觉能力报 unsupported 后不再换文件重试，也不因缺少视觉模型而阻塞。至多确定性列举一次文件名，只 inspect Theme、Commands、Overlay 和当前 Session config-option Provider，然后 define/run 一个 Theme Plugin。静态文件路径在 authoring 时固化为有序列表，背景使用 Theme 契约的安全默认值；滑动通过该 Plugin 自己的 theme registration.update 更新背景，通过 transaction preview/commit/rollback 更新 ACP。Theme、command、overlay 与事务共享 Fiber lifecycle，不使用 theme.subscribe、when.theme、Slots 或 code.host。
assertions: Treats user-supplied valid media as opaque assets unless content understanding materially improves the requested result
Makes at most one representative visual capability attempt and does not retry sibling assets or block Plugin creation after an unsupported result
Lists a static supplied asset directory at most once and derives ordering deterministically from filenames
Uses the live Theme contract defaults instead of inventing content-specific fit, anchor, opacity, or palette decisions
Queries exactly Theme, Commands, Overlay, and the advertised config-option Provider after one inspect list
Embeds the resolved static asset paths in code.client without adding code.host or runtime filesystem access
Updates the owned theme background through its registration while keeping visual positions separate from live ACP choices
Uses transaction preview, commit, and rollback for ACP config and restores the opening background on cancel
Keeps theme, command, overlay, and unfinished transaction in one Theme Plugin lifecycle without theme.subscribe, when.theme, Slots, or a side panel
Defines once and runs once after the minimal inspect path
